description: Minimal ontology for an MVP troubleshooting knowledge graph for a technical asset, optimized for chatbot-based problem diagnosis and resolution across manuals for robots, cobots, machines, controllers, printers, and similar systems.
design_principles: Center the ontology on troubleshooting rather than full product modeling.
Separate observed symptoms from underlying failure modes.
Represent corrective actions as operational remediation steps.
Keep the schema minimal, connected, and non-redundant.
Store provenance as node attributes when sufficient for the application.

nodes.name: Asset
nodes.description: The product, machine, robot, cobot, controller, or other technical asset that is the subject of troubleshooting knowledge.

nodes.name: Component
nodes.description: A physical or software component or subsystem of the asset involved in troubleshooting.

nodes.name: Symptom
nodes.description: An observed issue, anomaly, or visible manifestation detected by the user or system.

nodes.name: FailureMode
nodes.description: The underlying technical cause or failure mechanism that may explain one or more symptoms.

nodes.name: CorrectiveAction
nodes.description: An action, procedure, or remediation step intended to resolve a failure mode. A corrective action may be an operational procedure the technician performs (action_kind 'procedure') or a documented escalation the manual prescribes when it provides no on-site fix, e.g. 'contact your factory outlet / dealer / service' (action_kind 'escalation').

nodes.name: ErrorCode
nodes.description: A machine-generated error code or alert code produced by the asset and linked to troubleshooting knowledge.

relations.name: HAS_COMPONENT
relations.description: The asset includes the specified component.

relations.name: MAY_INDICATE
relations.description: The symptom may indicate the specified failure mode.

relations.name: AFFECTS
relations.description: The failure mode affects the specified component.

relations.name: RESOLVED_BY
relations.description: The failure mode may be resolved by the specified corrective action.

relations.name: GENERATES_ERROR
relations.description: The asset may generate the specified error code.

relations.name: INDICATES
relations.description: The error code indicates the specified failure mode.
